title: Towards Scalable Diagnostic-Driven Whole-Slide Image Retrieval for Pathology Archives
abstract: arXiv:2611.07935v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The growing adoption of digital pathology has rapidly expanded collections of hematoxylin-and-eosin whole-slide images, yet efficient navigation through these archives remains challenging, as metadata is often inconsistent or unavailable. Content-based image retrieval addresses this challenge by identifying similar cases directly from visual representations instead of manual annotations or metadata. Existing retrieval systems have demonstrated promising performance but largely rely on handcrafted indexing pipelines and predefined sampling strategies, constraining scalability and generalization. Here, we present CLEAR-WSI (Constant-Length Embedding for Automatic Retrieval of Whole-Slide Images) as a scalable, diagnostic-driven slide-retrieval framework, validated on both public and clinical data. translated_title: 面向病理档案的可扩展诊断驱动全切片图像检索
translated_abstract: 数字病理学的日益普及使苏木精-伊红（H&E）染色的全切片图像集合迅速扩大，然而由于元数据往往不一致或缺失，如何高效地浏览这些档案仍然具有挑战性。基于内容的图像检索通过直接从视觉表示中识别相似病例，而非依赖人工标注或元数据，来应对这一挑战。现有检索系统已展现出良好的性能，但大多依赖手工设计的索引流水线和预定义的采样策略，限制了其可扩展性和泛化能力。本文提出CLEAR-WSI（Constant-Length Embedding for Automatic Retrieval of Whole-Slide Images，用于全切片图像自动检索的定长嵌入），作为一种可扩展的、诊断驱动的切片检索框架，并在公开数据和临床数据上进行了验证。CLEAR-WSI采用固定长度的切片嵌入，并通过预测的诊断标签或真实标签对检索到的候选结果进行细化……
tldr: 提出了一种可扩展、诊断驱动的全切片图像检索框架CLEAR-WSI，通过固定长度的切片嵌入并利用诊断标签细化检索候选，摆脱了手工索引流水线，在公开和临床病理数据上实现了高效的相似病例检索。
en_tdlr: CLEAR-WSI is a scalable, diagnostic-driven whole-slide image retrieval framework that uses fixed-length slide embeddings and refines retrieved candidates with diagnostic labels, eliminating handcrafted indexing pipelines to enable efficient similar-case retrieval across public and clinical pathology archives.
